author: DRAGONRlDER
body:
##Jigsaw CTW

Hello, here I am today with a map for the map contest for you! As a brief overview, Jigsaw, is a map made by myself, featuring 4 teams in a CTW.  The map is spread out widely, being able to host 60 players at once.  It is aesthetically appealing, with stone accents on wood.  Getting into a wool room will automatically apply a kit to you, with 10 wool.  Wool should not drop.  No blocks should drop with the exception of stone bricks and any slabs/stairs, or any utility blocks.  Killing will give you 4 more logs, which can be crafted into planks.  Tools mine rather fast, so I'm not sure how defenses will go.  Because of that, no defense supplies are given.  Without further todo, here are several links about the map.

https://imgur.com/a/TQM7c  [Images Imgur]
https://pastebin.com/7KzjWrKP [XML Pastebin]
https://www.dropbox.com/s/2jq5s53vod5nx94/Jigsaw.zip?dl=0 [Download Dropbox]
